name: Viv Vision

abilityDetails.Suppression: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte azaltır.

abilityDetails.Plasma: Aktifken enerji hasarı verir, blok yeterliliğini %50 azaltır ve Mükemmel Blok şansını kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Energy Vulnerability: Enerji Direncini azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen enerji hasarını artırır.

abilitySections.title: Synthetic Anatomy - Always Active
content: Advanced robotics provide full Immunity to Poison and Bleed, and all Abilites gain 25% Ability Accuracy. Additionally, while she has an Armor Up effect, Viv is Immune to Nullify and Fateseal.
Viv starts each fight with 16 indefinite Armor Up Buffs, each increasing her Armor Rating by [271.98] If any are removed, they restore themselves one at a time, each taking 10 seconds.
If a Medium or Light Attack strikes Viv, she Power Drains 6% of the Opponent's current Power.

abilitySections.title: Solar Energy - Max Stacks: 15
content: Viv starts each fight with 1 Solar Energy. Every 4 seconds she gains another if she has less than 5.
When a stack of Solar Energy is consumed for any reason, Viv instantly gains 10% of a Bar of Power.
Viv's Light Combo Enders consume 1 Solar Energy to inflict a non-stacking 32% Suppression Debuff for 1.7 seconds, paused while Viv is using a Special Attack or not attacking.
Viv's Medium Combo Enders consume 1 Solar Energy to inflict a Heal Block Passive for 6 seconds, paused while Viv is attacking.

abilitySections.title: Phasing
content: When Viv would perform a Well-Timed Block, she has a 100% chance to instead gain a Phase Passive for 1 second, causing the incoming attack to Miss. While active, Viv is Immune to incoming Stun effects. This ability can't be used again until Viv consumes Solar Energy.
When an attack Misses Viv, she instantly Power Drains 30% of the Opponent's current Power. This can only happen once each time she Phases.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: The first hit Invalidates up to 3 Prowess from the Opponent. If any Prowess was removed this way, Viv gains 1 Solar Energy.
The final hit consumes 1 Solar Energy to inflict a burst of [13,726.7] Energy Damage, increased by 33% for each Prowess removed by the first hit.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: While the Opponent has less than 1 Bar of Power this attack is Passively Unblockable and generates no Power for the Opponent. These effects go on cooldown for 20 seconds if Viv is struck by a Special Attack 2 or 3.

Each hit consumes 1 Solar Energy to inflict an instant Incinerate dealing [15,838.5] Energy Damage. Against Mutants, inflict an instant Plasma instead. As a Defender this scales with Base Attack only.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, Viv converts up to 3 of her personal Armor Ups into Solar Energy.
Before each hit, Viv's powerful processing slows her perception of time as she calculates the optimal attack.
Tapping the Block Input during this slowed time causes the hit to convert up to 4 personal Armor Ups into Solar Energy and deals a burst of [5,279.5] Energy Damage, multiplied for each prior burst.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Grants an indefinite, non-stacking Fury Buff increasing Attack Rating by +[2,639.75]. This Buff cannot have its Ability Accuracy modified.
While this Buff is active, Viv has +75% Ability Accuracy and Immunity to Reversed Controls.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Proteinoid Android
content: While Viv has more than 5  Solar Energy, the amount of Power gained from consuming it is increased by [5 - 10]% flat.
Completing a 5-Hit Combo inflicts a dormant Energy Vulnerability. Max Stacks: 5.
Each of Viv's Special Attack 1 hits replaces a dormant Energy Vulnerability with an Energy Vulnerability Passive reducing the Opponent's Energy Resistance by [305.35 - 687.5] for 17 seconds.
